text:
Maya P: Heads-up team  RN draft is at https://git.redwood/release-notes/PR-478 please review. Planning a short internal announce at 12:10 PT and canary at 12:30 PT. Need final pin + canary wording.

Carlos R: pinging from release ops Can we confirm the staged image and exact pin command? Also want the short customer-facing blurb for hosted vs dedicated.

Priya: I'll tidy the customer blurb. Quick ask: can the internal announce include the expected impact matrix (latency, errors)? Keep it one line.

Sam O: I'm oncall 12:0014:00 PT. I'll monitor SLA dashboards. Rollback threshold: p50 > +40% or errors > 2% sustained 3m.

Carlos R: artifact is `redwood-infer:stable-1.10.0`. Pin command for ops: `./deployctl pin --svc infer --image redwood-infer:stable-1.10.0 --env staging,hosted`

Priya: internal announce copy draft: "Rolling update to inference runtime (stable-1.10.0). Canary 12:30 PT -> 20% at 12:45 -> full by 13:30 PT. Oncall: @Sam O. Rollback plan: revert to stable-1.9.8 if regressions." Thoughts?

Maya P: looks good. Maybe soften "rollback plan" to "rollback trigger/command" so it's actionable.

Carlos R: agree. Also include contact for Dedicated account managers in the announce.

deploy-bot: preflight triggered by Carlos R at 12:05 PT. Checks: image licensing, kernel-compat, quant-smoke. ETA ~3m. Posting results here.

InfraTeamBot: Capacity reserve executed at 12:08 PT for pool infer-prod-small. Reserved 40% headroom.

deploy-bot: Preflight results: PASS except a warning on AVX512 kernel mismatch on one node group (non-critical). Recommend proceed with canary but monitor that node group's eviction metrics.

Sam O: noted. I'll watch node eviction and retry counts. If retries spike >100/min we abort.

Priya: update to internal copy: "Note: dedicated customers may see a brief config toggle for model pinning; no data plane changes expected."

Maya P: final checklist before announce: (1) PR approved for RN, (2) deploy-bot preflight pass (ok), (3) pin command verified (ok), (4) oncall named (Sam). Carlos please post the internal announce at 12:10 PT.

Carlos R: will send now. Internal announce (to all-eng + customers-internal):
```
Heads-up: rolling update to inference runtime (redwood-infer:stable-1.10.0).
Canary: 12:30 PT -> 20% at 12:45 PT -> full by 13:30 PT.
Support: @Sam O oncall (12:0014:00 PT). Monitor token latency and top failure prompts.
Rollback: revert to stable-1.9.8 via `./deployctl rollback --svc infer --to stable-1.9.8` if regressions.
Dedicated customers: expect a short config toggle for pinning; no data plane changes.
```

Priya: small edit: change "token latency" to "token-level latency" and add link to RN PR. Carlos can you include PR link?

Carlos R: updated and posted.

Sam O: +1. Starting active monitoring at 12:25 PT.

Maya P: thanks all. If no issues during 12:30 canary we proceed to 20% at 12:45.

Carlos R: note for ops: if deploy-bot flags a rollback-worthy failure we use the staged rollback command; otherwise manual rollback via above command.

InfraTeamBot: Reminder: post-deploy job scheduled at 13:40 PT to run smoke e2e and quant-checks. Results posted in this thread.

Sam O: will post a short status update at 12:40 PT and 13:00 PT.

Priya: RN PR merged. I'll push finalized customer blurb to docs site after 13:40 PT checks.

Maya P: great job team :tada:
